directory.faq.heading: About the List
directory.faq.title: List Questions
directory.faq.subtitle: Criteria and resources
directory.faq.q1: What criteria does 0x Leñador use to include a site in this list?
directory.faq.a1: We prioritize platforms with a proven reputation that 0x Leñador actively uses. However, the Web3 environment is highly experimental; even solid projects can suffer hacks or insolvency. This list is not financial advice. You must do your own research (DYOR) and always operate at your own risk.
directory.faq.a2: It indicates a referral link. By using it (at no extra cost to you), you financially support 0x Leñador, providing the resources needed to keep building this project. Inclusion of these sites remains strictly subject to our quality and security criteria.
directory.faq.q3: How do I suggest a site or report a broken link?
directory.faq.a3: Contact us via Telegram or X (@0xlenador). We evaluate all suggestions before adding them. If you spot a broken or suspicious link, please notify us immediately to protect the community.
directory.faq.q4: How often is this list updated?
directory.faq.a4: The list is constantly reviewed. We add new sites as we incorporate them into our daily operations and remove those that no longer meet our security or quality standards.
directory.faq.q5: Do I need to connect my wallet to all these sites?
directory.faq.a5: No. You should only connect your wallet when you are going to interact directly with a protocol (such as a DEX or a Bridge). For analytics or data reading sites, it is usually not necessary. Remember to always read the permissions you sign.
directory.faq.q6: Why are some popular or 'trendy' projects missing from this list?
directory.faq.a6: This is not an exhaustive database, but a curated list. We prefer quality over quantity. If a popular project is missing, it may be because we don't use it operationally, it hasn't passed our security filters, or we simply haven't evaluated it yet.
